title: CPSC, FAO Schwarz Inc. Announce Recall of Fire Engine Pull-Along Toys
summary: Small parts can detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to small children. Units: 323.

title: CPSC, Lasko Products Inc. Announce Recall of Space Heaters
summary: The power cord connection can overheat and cause the cord to separate from the space heater. This poses a fire, burn and shock hazard. Units: 186,000.

title: CPSC, Brand Imports, LLC Announce Recall of Children's Rings
summary: The rings contain high levels of lead, posing a risk of lead poisoning to young children. Units: 1 million.

title: CPSC, Wagner Spray Tech Corporation Announce Recall of Drill Charger Base
summary: A defective battery can cause the charger base to overheat, causing the base to melt and possibly burn nearby objects. Units: 180,000.

title: CPSC, Bath & Body Works Announce Recall of Votive Candles
summary: These votive candles can burn with a high flame or irregular flame posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 733,000.

title: CPSC, APA Marketing Inc. Announce Recall of Home Entertainment Wall Units
summary: The control box for the touch dimmer lighting mechanism can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 400.

title: CPSC, Brass Light Gallery Announce Recall of Wall Sconces
summary: The tie-downs, which secure the electrical wires to the mounting bracket, may come loose, causing the wire to touch the bulb and pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 1,400.

title: CPSC, Lakewood Announce Recall of Electric Heaters
summary: Electrical connections inside of the heater can become loose. This could cause the metal portion of the heater to become energized, posing a serious shock hazard to consumers. Units: 150,000.

title: CPSC, Palliser Furniture Ltd. Announce Recall of "Poof" Chairs
summary: A metal rod can protrude through the fabric and its sharp edges could cause scratches or cuts. Units: 155.

title: CPSC, Salton, Inc. Announce Recall of Timex Outdoor Appliance Timers
summary: The Timex timers have reverse polarity in the wiring, which allows current to flow to the attached appliance when the timer is turned off. Consumers can receive an electric shock. Units: 16,700.

title: CPSC, Char-Broil® Announce Recall of Gas Grills to Replace Temperature Gauges
summary: If moisture gets inside the temperature gauge, the glass cover on the gauge can break, posing a risk of injury to people nearby. Units: 108,000.

title: CPSC, Harbor Freight Tools Announce Recall of Heavy Duty Portable Industrial Cord Reel
summary: Electric shock or fire possible because the internal grounding conductor may not be properly secured to the receptacle. Units: 9,390.

title: CPSC, Lado Co. of America Announce Recall of Hair Dryers
summary: These hair dryers do not have an immersion protection device or ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) on the power cord, which poses a serious electrocution hazard if dropped in water. title: CPSC, Light Distribution Inc. Announce Recall of Hair Dryers
summary: These hair dryers do not have an immersion protection device or ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) on the power cord, which poses a serious electrocution hazard if dropped in water. title: CPSC, Tristar Products Inc. Announce Recall of Revised Design Steam Cleaner
summary: Hot water and steam can escape from the steam cleaner's handle and inner hose, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: 5,000.

title: CPSC, Babies "R" Us and Playwell Announce Recall of Snail Push Toys
summary: The screw securing the toy handle to the push toy could detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 900.

title: CPSC, Kingfisher Publications Announce Recall of Children’s Easter Books
summary: A sponge "touch-and-feel" item inside the book can detach, or small pieces can be torn away, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Lithonia Lighting Announce Recall of Indoor HID Light Fixtures
summary: A component in the light fixture can leak fluid, which can degrade the acrylic lenses and reflectors, causing them to crack and fall. Falling pieces of acrylic can injure someone below the fixture. Units: About 52,600.

title: CPSC, Fedders Corporation Announce Recall to Repair Window Air Conditioners with Electric Heat
summary: If the outside fan blade becomes blocked, when operating in the heating mode, this unit could present a fire hazard. Units: About 13,500.

title: CPSC, Stanley Furniture Company Inc. Announce Recall of Cribs
summary: An incorrect screw (used to attach the movable gate) was provided for the assembly of some of these cribs. The crib cannot be assembled using this screw. title: CPSC, Murray Inc. Announce Recall of Lawn Mowers and Lawn Tractors
summary: Plastic components on these lawn mowers and lawn tractors can crack, if they are struck by an object thrown from the blade. Objects can be ejected from the mower unexpectedly and could hit nearby consumers. Units: About 8,000.

title: CPSC, Murray Inc. Announce Recall of Lawn Tractors
summary: The fuel tank can develop cracks, allowing fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 93,500.
